verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API. A platform like this could plausibly offer stored workflows or prompts with versioning, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no user-facing way to version, review, or roll back automations. The deprecations policy and API changelog cover Groq's own model and endpoint lifecycle, not user automations, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
